Bahera Powder Manufacturer: Bahera Powder from Tradenest Naturals

Bahera powder is the fine milled dried fruit of Terminalia bellirica, one of the three fruits in the classic Ayurvedic Triphala blend. Tradenest Naturals is a bahera powder manufacturer in Surat, India, supplying herbal, supplement and Ayurvedic brands worldwide. As a wholesale bahera powder supplier in India, we also offer private label packing under your brand. Looking to buy bahera powder in commercial quantities? We produce it to a clear, agreed specification. Our raw fruit is carefully selected and sourced from trusted growers, which helps us keep quality steady and prices fair. Our bulk Terminalia bellirica is used in supplements, traditional formulations and herbal food products.

Advanced Manufacturing and Processing Excellence

Good powder starts with good fruit. Our sourcing team selects mature, well-dried bahera fruits. We then clean them, remove the seeds where required and mill the dried fruit under controlled conditions. The result is a pure bahera fruit powder with its typical brown colour, astringent taste and fine, even texture. Milling and sieving equipment gives a uniform particle size. Each batch is checked for moisture, mesh and appearance before packing. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation, and third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost. This keeps the process transparent and the product consistent.

Key Features of Our Terminalia Bellirica Powder Wholesale

  • Single-ingredient Terminalia bellirica powder with no added fillers or synthetic additives.
  • Fine milled to 80-100 mesh for smooth blending.
  • Moisture held below 8.0% to support a 24 month shelf life.
  • Batch traceability from raw material to export packing.

Exceptional Buyer Benefits and Value

Working with Tradenest Naturals has clear commercial advantages. First, the MOQ is just 5 Kg, so you can start small. Second, we quote clear bahera powder price per kg rates for bulk buyers. We are also an IEC registered exporter and provide export documentation support. Whether you need standard bulk packs or custom retail pouches, we work to your specification. Our packaging protects the powder from humidity during transit. That is why herbal brands come back to us as their regular bahera powder exporter.

Versatile Applications Across Industries

Bahera powder serves several commercial sectors. Supplement makers use it in herbal capsules and tablets. Ayurvedic manufacturers include it in Triphala blends and other traditional formulations. Cosmetic brands use its astringent character in herbal face packs and skin care products.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is the minimum order quantity for bahera powder?

The MOQ is 5 Kg. Larger bulk orders and trial runs for new partners are both welcome.

What certifications and quality standards apply?

Tradenest Naturals is an FSSAI licensed food business. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation, and third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost.

What are the packaging and shelf-life options?

We pack in moisture-barrier food-grade bags, fibre drums and stand-up pouches. Shelf life is 24 months when stored correctly.

What are the typical specifications (mesh, moisture, purity)?

The standard powder is fine milled to 80-100 mesh, with moisture below 8.0%. It is a single-ingredient fruit powder with no artificial additives.

What is the lead time and how do I request a sample or quote?

Lead time depends on order size and packaging, and we confirm it with each quotation. Contact our sales team to request a formal quote or a product sample.
